git.title: Git commit prefix cheat sheet
git.intro: Follow these standardized prefixes to keep your git history clean, readable, and structured.

desc.feat: — Adding a new feature or functionality.
desc.fix: — Resolving a bug or unexpected behavior.
desc.refactor: — Rewriting code to improve structure without changing behavior.
desc.perf: — Improving performance, memory, or execution speed.
desc.docs: — Updating documentation, READMEs, or article titles.
desc.style: — Adjusting formatting, fixing typos, or tweaking UI spacing.
desc.chore: — Updating dependencies, build tools, or config files.

gannet.title: Sports water bottle: Gannet
gannet.intro: Gannet is a specialized sports water bottle designed to support athletic recovery and hydration in one package.
gannet.feature1: Detachable icing sheet — Comes with a removable cooling sheet built directly into the bottle.
gannet.feature2: Post-workout support — Wrap the sheet around arms or legs after exercise to soothe and recover fatigued muscles.
